# Xentris Tech (XENTRIS LLC)

> Technology company based in Merrick, New York. Builds custom software, cloud
> infrastructure and DevOps, AI automation and custom GPTs, and provides digital
> transformation and cybersecurity consulting. Serves clients across the United
> States and Latin America, in English and Spanish. Founded by Farid Enrique
> Jiménez Campo. Tagline: "Technology that moves the business, not just the roadmap".

## What it offers

- **Custom software**: web and mobile applications built around the client's operation.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: infrastructure, continuous deployment and 24/7 monitoring.
- **AI & automation**: LLM integration, custom GPTs, agents and pipelines that remove manual work.
- **Digital transformation & cybersecurity**: consulting to modernize existing systems safely.

## Pages and profiles

- [Corporate site](https://xentris.tech): services, approach and contact.
- [Xentris Tech on GitHub](https://github.com/xentristech): public projects and open source tools.
- [Farid Jiménez, founder](https://github.com/dirafweb): the founder's technical profile, with an AI assistant that answers questions.

## Open source projects

- [claude-skills](https://github.com/xentristech/claude-skills): installable Agent Skills for AI SEO (GEO/AEO), technical SEO audits, VPS deployment with HTTPS and auto-deploy, self-healing remote access over Tailscale, and project memory.
- [inventario-ia](https://github.com/xentristech/inventario-ia): inventory system for YOTA Montacargas, in TypeScript.
- [detector-velas](https://github.com/xentristech/detector-velas): Japanese candlestick pattern detector for crypto with a streaming AI verdict. Next.js.
- [tradingprogpt](https://github.com/xentristech/tradingprogpt): read-only MCP server over MetaTrader 5 and Twelve Data with an LLM analysis layer. Python.
- [carta-viva](https://github.com/xentristech/carta-viva): astrological natal chart with an AI chat.
- [xentris-web](https://github.com/xentristech/xentris-web): bilingual corporate site with an AI assistant.
